maddeler.e:
استشهدنا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْهَدْنَا (istašhadnā) /is.taʃ.had.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada)
# اُسْتُشْهِدْنَا (ustušhidnā) /us.tuʃ.hid.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَشْهَدَ (istašhada) and اُسْتُشْهِدَ (ustušhida)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
